body: Surfaced refining DASH-54/55: they were added without 'source' (older board.py / out-of-band), the newer validate_item requires it, and 'edit' has no --source flag, so the only repair was an out-of-band backfill + mutate_roadmap re-stamp. Fix: add --source to the edit verb (one-liner) and/or have 'add' refuse to omit it. Also: milestone-add (mutate_roadmap) leaves milestone.items=[] until a mutate_items verb syncs membership — a fresh milestone with pre-versioned items renders invalid until then.
title: board.py: 'edit' verb can't set 'source'; items added out-of-band (older/hand) lack required field and are CLI-unrepairable

body: When lesson_registry.py status <id> enforced succeeds (E2a) and the lesson's target_path resolves to a rule line naming a backing script, stamp that line with an explicit (enforcement: hook|stop-gate|ci) tag so determinism_gap_scan.py stops reporting it as an untagged GAP once the hook is wired. Closes the loop between the lesson lifecycle (candidate->recorded->promoted->enforced) and the per-rule enforcement-tag mechanism shipped in project-meta 1.28.0. Terminology note: lesson 'enforced' = evidence graduation; '(enforcement: ...)' tag = mechanical wiring intent — keep vocabularies distinct.
title: Wire lesson 'enforced' status to determinism enforcement tags
